visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a tan baseball cap and an orange-and-white striped shirt sits in a restaurant. He uses chopsticks to pick up a pan-fried dumpling from a white rectangular plate. The background is a plain dark gray wall with bright indoor lighting. Yellow and red variety-style text overlays appear centrally. (2) Close-up on a small metal dish containing a dark liquid sauce. The man dips the dumpling into the sauce. He then takes a large bite, closing his eyes and smiling widely to indicate pleasure. The camera is slightly tilted. (3) A second man with black curly hair, wearing a black cardigan over a dark shirt, appears in a medium shot. He sits across the table from the first man. He gestures toward the food. The environment has white-tiled tables and warm indoor lighting. (4) The second man points to a small dish of thick, dark brown sauce. The first man looks at it with curiosity, then dips his dumpling and reacts with wide-eyed shock and delight. Variety text highlights the sauce's name. (5) A third man wearing a white and black zip-up tracksuit appears. He has short black hair. He places a white paper cup with red branding on the table with a firm movement. He looks directly at the camera with a serious, confident expression. (6) The third man dips a pan-fried dumpling directly into the white liquid (soy milk) inside the paper cup. The first two men are shown in a reaction shot with exaggerated expressions of disbelief and shock. (7) All three men are shown together. The third man explains the technique while gesturing. The first two men nod vigorously and smile, looking impressed. High-energy variety text fills the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, upbeat electronic pop music begins. A male voice (Person A) speaks with high pitch and energetic arousal, alternating between Japanese and Chinese phrases. Short percussive sounds of chopsticks hitting the plate are audible. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers as the second voice (Person B) enters. His voice is lower in pitch, calm, and has an authoritative yet friendly tone. The BGM continues at a steady 128 BPM. (3) Vocal interaction between A and B follows. Person A's voice rises in pitch and volume as a 'whoosh' SFX transitions into a loud 'pop' sound when he tries the thick sauce. (4) A heavy 'thud' SFX marks the arrival of a third male voice (Person C). His tone is professional and highly dominant, like a master explaining a secret. The ambient noise floor is low, typical of a studio-produced restaurant scene. (5) A collective high-pitched vocal reaction from Person A and B follows a digital UI 'ping' sound. Person C continues speaking with clear articulation and moderate speed. (6) The BGM volume swells slightly. A series of 'sparkle' and 'comic' SFX play as the explanation reaches its climax. The video ends with a synchronized, loud, high-valence shout from all three speakers.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Progression of stages (1st year, 3rd year, 10th year) -> Final revelation -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously educate viewers on increasingly 'authentic' Taiwanese ways to eat pan-fried dumplings, transitioning from standard sauce to thick soy paste, and finally to dipping in soy milk.
